title: 第5章 林家上门第6章 凝气九层
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
苏家老爷子苏圣杰眉头紧蹙，一脸焦急，冲着苏铭喝道：“铭儿，不可接受！这是秦天霸的阴谋，你去了只有死路一条！”
苏铭嘴角勾起一抹不羁的弧度，目光如炬，直射秦天霸，寒声道：“秦天霸，你想找死，那我便成全你！这挑战，我接了！”
秦天霸闻言，先是一怔，旋即仰头大笑起来，笑声肆意张狂：“苏铭，你莫不是被吓傻了？竟真敢应下！明日，便是你的死期！”
苏铭心中冷笑，面上却不动声色。旁人不知，他如今手中可是攥着四十二枚灵魄丹呢。这灵魄丹，对于洛安城来说，那可都是稀世珍宝，每一枚都珍贵得让人眼红心跳。有了这等宝贝，他苏铭又岂会怕了秦天霸这挑衅？
“哼，到底谁死，还不一定呢！”苏铭暗自低语，眼神愈发坚定。
周围众人见状，顿时一片哗然。
“这苏铭莫不是疯了？怎敢答应这根本不可能战胜的战斗？”
“就是就是，秦天霸何等厉害，苏铭去了，那不是白白送死吗？”
众人交头接耳，眼神中满是震惊与疑惑，或摇头叹息，或满脸难以置信。
场面瞬间变得嘈杂无比，一道道目光，像一道道聚光灯，齐齐射向苏铭，仿佛要将他看穿。
苏家家族四长老，此刻满脸不屑，冷哼一声道：
“哼！苏铭那废物，毫无能耐也就罢了，竟又闯出祸事。这般模样，早该卸任少家主之位，免得继续丢我苏家脸面！”
其声音尖锐，带着浓浓的鄙夷，好似对苏铭厌恶到了极点。
七长老立马站出来，随声附和，脸上堆满了谄媚：
“四长老所言极是！苏铭这小子，实在不成器，哪有半分少家主的样子，确实该换人了！”
苏家老爷子苏圣杰，面色阴沉似水，眼眸如电，将站出来的这几个长老一一记下。
他没有当场回驳，只是稍作沉吟后，沉声道：
“半月后，洛安城四大家族天才战开启。我苏家年轻一辈，谁在其中排名高，谁便是少家主！”
话落，周遭一片哗然，诸多子弟眼中闪烁起炽热光芒。
而老爷子苏圣杰，心中却暗自思忖：“这几个老东西，竟敢在这时候落井下石。哼！找个机会，定要将他们一一宰了，这般不忠不义之徒，留着必是苏家大患！”

他微微眯起双眼，眼神中闪过一丝狠厉，周身气息也随之微微波动，仿佛能预见那几个长老的凄惨下场。
与此同时，大长老苏凌虚起身告退，他面上古井无波，心内却似有一头猛兽在兴奋地咆哮。
“哼，这一次，局势对我苏家分支可是大大有利。”他暗自思忖，嘴角微微勾起一抹不易察觉的弧度。
旋即，他目光一转，看向一旁亭亭玉立的少女，正是他的孙女苏紫寒。
苏紫寒身姿婀娜，肌肤赛雪，眼眸灵动如星，琼鼻秀挺，樱唇不点而朱，一头乌黑亮丽的长发如瀑般垂下，尽显倾国倾城之貌。此刻的她，静静地站在那里，宛如一朵盛开在寒夜中的傲雪寒梅，清冷而绝美。
“紫寒，”苏凌虚开口，声音低沉却透着几分期待，“你如今已达聚元境三层，这一次，可是有极大的机会，去争一争那原本该属于我们这一脉的少家主之位。”
苏紫寒美目流转，眼神中闪过一丝跃跃欲试，轻声应道：“爷爷放心，孙女定不会让您失望。那所谓的苏铭，想独占少家主之位？哼，我定要让他知道，这位置，我苏紫寒也有资格染指！”
苏凌虚微微点头，眼中满是赞许：“不错，我苏家分支蛰伏许久，也该是时候崛起了。你只管放手去做，爷爷自会在背后为你兜底。那苏铭，可能有些能耐，但咱们也绝非吃素的！”
苏紫寒玉手紧握，贝齿轻咬下唇，娇俏的脸上满是坚定：“好，此番定要在众人面前大放异彩，让所有人都知道，我苏紫寒可不是好惹的！少家主之位，我志在必得！”
老爷子待众人离去，眉头一皱，看向苏铭，问道：“铭儿，你咋就答应了秦天霸那厮的生死斗？”
content_en:
The old man of the Su family, Su Shengjie, frowned, with an anxious look on his face, and shouted at Su Ming: "Ming'er, this is unacceptable! This is Qin Tianba's conspiracy. You will only die if you go!"
The corner of Su Ming's mouth curled up with an unruly arc, his gaze was like a torch, directed at Qin Tianba, and said in a cold voice: "Qin Tianba, if you want to die, then I will help you! I accept this challenge!"
When Qin Tianba heard this, he was startled for a moment, then raised his head and laughed wildly, "Su Ming, are you scared to death? How dare you agree! Tomorrow will be your death day!"
Su Ming sneered in his heart, but his face remained calm. Unknown to others, he now holds forty-two soul pills in his hand. This soul pill is a rare treasure for Luo'an City, and each one is so precious that it makes people jealous. With such a treasure, how could he, Su Ming, be afraid of Qin Tianba's provocation?
"Hmph, it's not certain who will die!" Su Ming whispered secretly, his eyes becoming firmer.
When everyone around him saw this, they were in an uproar.
"Is this Su Ming crazy? How dare he agree to this impossible-to-win battle?"
"That's right, Qin Tianba is so powerful. If Su Ming goes away, isn't it a waste of time to die?"
Everyone was whispering to each other, their eyes full of shock and confusion, some shaking their heads and sighing, or others looking in disbelief.
The scene instantly became extremely noisy, and gazes, like spotlights, were directed at Su Ming, as if they wanted to see through him.
The fourth elder of the Su family looked disdainful at the moment and snorted coldly:
"Hmph! That good-for-nothing Su Ming is just incompetent, yet he got into trouble again. With a look like this, he should have resigned as the young head of the family long ago, so as not to continue to embarrass my Su family!"
His voice was sharp and full of contempt, as if he hated Su Ming to the extreme.
The seventh elder immediately stood up and echoed, his face full of flattery:
"What the fourth elder said is absolutely true! Su Ming is really incompetent. He doesn't look like the young master of the family at all. It's time to replace him!"
Su Shengjie, the old man of the Su family, with a gloomy face and eyes like lightning, took note of the elders who stood up one by one.
He did not reply on the spot, but after pondering for a moment, he said in a deep voice:
"Half a month later, the genius battle between the four major families in Luo'an City will begin. Among the younger generations of my Su family, whoever ranks high among them will be the young family head!"
As soon as he finished speaking, there was an uproar around him, and the eyes of many disciples flashed with blazing light.
But the old man, Su Shengjie, was thinking to himself: "How dare these old guys add insult to injury at this time. Huh! If we find an opportunity, we must kill them one by one. Keeping such unfaithful and unjust people will definitely be a big problem for the Su family!"
He narrowed his eyes slightly, a fierce look flashed in his eyes, and the aura around him fluctuated slightly, as if he could foresee the tragic end of those elders.
At the same time, the Great Elder Su Lingxu stood up and left. His face was calm, but in his heart there seemed to be a beast roaring excitedly.
"Hmph, this time, the situation is very favorable for our branch of the Su family." He thought to himself, with an imperceptible arc at the corner of his mouth.
Immediately, he turned his eyes and looked at the graceful girl beside him, who was his granddaughter Su Zihan.
Su Zihan has a graceful figure, skin as white as snow, eyes as smart as stars, a straight nose, pink lips, and long black and bright hair hanging down like a waterfall, showing her an alluring appearance. At this moment, she stood there quietly, like an arrogant snowy plum blooming in the cold night, cold and beautiful.
"Zihan," Su Lingxu said, his voice low but full of expectation, "You have now reached the third level of the Juyuan Realm. This time, you have a great opportunity to compete for the position of the young family head that should belong to our lineage."
Su Zihan's beautiful eyes turned, and there was a hint of eagerness in her eyes, and she responded softly: "Grandpa, don't worry, my granddaughter will not disappoint you. The so-called Su Ming, wants to monopolize the position of the young family head? Hum, I must let youHe knows that I, Su Zihan, am also qualified to get involved in this position! "
Su Lingxu nodded slightly, his eyes full of approval: "Yes, my branch of the Su family has been dormant for a long time, and it is time to rise. Just go ahead and do it, and grandpa will take care of it for you. That Su Ming may have some abilities, but we are definitely not vegetarians! "
Su Zihan clenched her hands tightly, biting her lower lip lightly, her pretty face full of determination: "Okay, this time I will shine in front of everyone, let everyone know that I, Su Zihan, am not someone to be trifled with! I am determined to win the position of Young Patriarch! "
The old man waited for everyone to leave, frowned, looked at Su Ming, and asked: "Ming'er, why did you agree to a life-and-death fight with Qin Tianba? "
